scope: Four servings of three cups. Twelve cups use an estimated 25 g of cucumber and 20 g filling each. The tuna is weighed drained, and the cucumber is weighed after hollowing. AFCD F009300 matches the drained water-packed tuna type; fat content varies by brand. AFCD F003320 is a raw unpeeled cucumber composition proxy for cups after the centres are removed. Preparation was reviewed against two independent cucumber cup recipes. The exact mass and number were not physically tested.
